name: security_bitwarden
description: Bitwarden password manager through its own MCP server (github.com/bitwarden/mcp-server), cloned on first use into ~/.usemcpkit/repos/security/bitwarden, built there and run locally: vault items, folders, attachments, Send, password and TOTP tools.
